program.help:
Run KlustaKwik automatic spike sorting for each spikeDetection group.
Runs KlustaKwik on each spikeDetection group in sequence. For each group, reads the .fet.N feature file produced by ndm_pca and writes a .clu.N cluster assignment file. Groups for which a .clu.N already exists are skipped.
The UseFeatures mask is constructed automatically from the per-group channel count and nFeatures value: all PCA features plus one energy feature per channel are enabled.
PARAMETERS
All mandatory parameters (channel count, nFeatures, sampling rate) are read from the 'Acquisition System' and 'Spike Groups' sections of the parameter file.
# minClusters
Minimum number of clusters passed to KlustaKwik -MinClusters (default 2).
# maxClusters
Maximum number of clusters passed to KlustaKwik -MaxClusters. For high-density probes with many channels a value of 50-100 is reasonable; for tetrodes 12-20 is typical (default 100).
# chunkMinutes
Duration in minutes for three-phase temporal chunking (-ChunkMinutes). Chunked mode splits the recording into windows, sorts each independently, and then merges the per-chunk models — useful for long recordings with electrode drift. Set to 0 to disable chunked mode and use standard two-phase CEM (default 5).
# initMethod
Cluster centre initialisation method passed to KlustaKwik -InitMethod. Use "random" for standard random initialisation or "farthest" for farthest-point seeding, which often gives better initial separation (default "random").
# mergeThresh
Maximum inter-chunk Mahalanobis distance for merging two per-chunk models in the global merge pass (-MergeThresh). Increase to allow more aggressive merging across chunks (default 35).
# globalMergeIter
Number of EM iterations run on the globally merged solution after the chunk merge pass (-GlobalMergeIter, default 30).
# timeMergeIter
Phase-2 merge iterations in two-phase CEM mode (-TimeMergeIter). Set to 0 to disable two-phase mode (default 35).
# saveIntermediates
Set to 1 to write .clu.N whenever a new best score is found during sorting. Set to 0 to produce only the final .clu.N file (default 0). Setting to 1 can be useful for inspecting intermediate states on very long runs, but produces many files.
